newsitem.title: CHINA: China plans Bohai oil, gas pipeline.
newsitem.headline: China plans Bohai oil, gas pipeline.

text.p: China plans to begin work on an oil and natural gas pipeline linking fields in the Bohai Bay with several eastern cities, officials said on Thursday.

"Work on the project will begin in the second half of this year," an official of the Bohai company, a subsidiary of the China National Offshore Oil Corporation said by telephone from the eastern city of Tianjin.
He declined to estimate the cost of the project.
The first 40-km phase of a 200-km underwater pipeline connecting oilfields in southern and western Bohai Bay will be completed by the end of this year.
Eventually, the project will bring gas to Tianjin as well as cities such as Tangshan and Qinhuangdao, the official said.
